note: The Atlas engine is built from the public Enntity/atlas fork at this exact commit; build.sh refuses any other tree.

upstream_candidate.note: GLM-5.3 Flash support and optimizations intended for Atlas-Inf review; not yet proposed upstream.

sparkglm_only.note: FlashKDA prefill and native sparse-MLA prefill bridges plus their build sources (scripts/dev/glm_sparse_native, research/flash-kda-prefill).

integration.note: The SparkGLM-only layer (0965f8d5) plus 116 commits merged from reviewed topic branches on the Enntity/atlas fork: the sparse-index key normalization race fix and other kernel race hardening, whole-block prefix sharing, KV sizing that survives a co-tenant releasing memory, the prefix-cache policy, exact prefill and decode kernels, and a rank-mirrored KV admission vote. Most of it is intended for the upstream candidate; that branch has not been rebuilt from it yet.
